scope: P0 followed by P1 on the existing train600 only, with a parallel theory and historical-evidence workstream
features: frozen fold-local MiniLM-L6 384D, PCA16, StandardScaler, leading constant; no task or subtask features
reward_target: mean of the three original aggregate correctness observations for each history question and physical action
empirical_max_weights: uniform over all exact empirical maximizers on each history question
training_T: all20 empirical mean rewards exactly equal on a history question; never used to filter evaluation questions
objective: F_beta(W) = (1/N) sum_i omega_i(beta) [max_j(2 phi_i W_j-r_ij) - sum_j alpha_ij(2 phi_i W_j-r_ij)] + regularization ||W||_F^2
row_weight: omega_i=beta on history T; omega_i=1 otherwise
penalty: same positive identity operator on every W entry including constant-feature coefficients; no new regularization or rescaling
regularization_source: frozen E8 M4 final_diagnostics inherited by E17; no E19 parameter search

solver.name: Clarabel exact convex epigraph QP
solver.initialization: fresh DefaultSolver on every fit, no supplied warm start
solver.unique_quantity: W is unique from positive L2; zero-weight epigraph auxiliary coordinates need not be unique

P0.qualification_permutation: reverse20, numeric column j represents physical action19-j
P0.endpoint_inequality: 0 <= F0(W_B)-F0(W_C) <= J_T(W_C)-J_T(W_B), within declared numerical tolerance
P0.gate: all objective, KKT, mapping and endpoint optimality checks pass before any remaining real-data fit

deployment.policy: uniform probability on the numerically qualified argmax set, evaluated exactly by summing the frozen cache rewards
deployment.definition: actions with score >= maximum score - 1e-8 receive probability1/set_size
deployment.raw_exact_argmax_uniform: saved separately as a floating-point sensitivity diagnostic
deployment.strict_change: both B and C have strict winners and the physical winning actions differ

evaluation_access: freeze W, complete score vectors, both uniform probability definitions and a receipt before decoding that fold's evaluation rewards
history_reward_reader: decode only selected H rows of the numeric NPZ member; evaluation rows remain raw skipped bytes until prediction freeze
primary_effect: C minus B final aggregate correctness, averaged inside each three-generation question cluster, with GSM8K/BBH each0.5
correction_accounting: report deterministic strict-change corrections separately; all-policy randomized expected corrections/damages use permutation-equivariant maximal same-action overlap coupling, with independent residual action draws
bbh_subtask_macro: reported separately, without changing the primary weights

bootstrap.unit: original question with both policies and all three cached generation repetitions

uncertainty_scope: repeatedly used train600 OOF development, conditional on fitted heads; overlapping five-fold histories do not form independent repetitions
stop_rules: common-score shifts or inference-tie-only effects cannot support a strict cross-question ranking claim
imprecise utility retains mechanism evidence without starting independent evaluation
positive and negative utility directions are both preserved without choosing another beta
public_artifact_rule: Question-level scores, masks, rewards, identities and weights stay private. Public release contains aggregate results, code and source hashes.
